ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; dominant high-intensity (white) central region across both lobes bordered by a low-intensity (black/dark-grey) continuous perimeter along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white region occupying >90% of visible surface; low-intensity border mapping the trailing edge; localized brown/dark-grey pixel clusters at distal tips; minor diffuse grey speckling at the lower water-contact interface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression; calculated pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees with significant depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) observed along the entire trailing edge boundary from notch to tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Continuous convex curvature fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, localized high-contrast brown and dark-grey pixel clusters at the distal tips of both lobes, exhibiting irregular circular geometry.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological colonization (barnacle clusters) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
